title: AnimeOrg
tagline: Get your Anime in your city in nearest theaters on public demand
description: Current day movie ticket booking apps do not provide the facitlity to organize movie on public demand. There is always a doubt about how the movie would do economically especially in smaller cities where the fanbase is sparce. Our protocol aims to concentrate audiences to make the screening of the shows economically feasible in a trustless decentralized way. You can get your fovorite movie(anime) screenced in your city if the movie has got a considerable following, and the stake amount crosses the benchmark at which theaters are economically interested in that particular movie. NFT tickets are awarded if the movie is screened, else the staked amount is refunded.
